svg.title: TurboVLA training loop in lerobot-nexarm
svg.desc: Simulated and real demonstrations are mixed by a sampler with a fixed real ratio; the collator normalizes images, state and 16-step action chunks with padding flags; the model predicts a 16 by 6 chunk; a masked L1 loss with an optional gripper weight is computed over valid steps; AdamW with gradient clipping and a warm-up plus cosine schedule updates the weights; an exponential moving average of the weights is saved with the statistics and config every 5,000 steps.
svg.text: TurboVLA learns from mixed real and simulated runs.
examples/nexarm/train_turbovla.py · 50,000 steps · click a block or use the arrow keys

g.text: each sample: real with p = r, sim with 1 − r · with replacement
--real-ratio 0.5 · --no-sim trains on real data only · batch 16 per GPU
min / max merged over the sim and real statistics
instruction strings, kept as text for BERT
action chunk, 16 steps · action_is_pad marks steps past the episode end
the network from the Inference tab
state projection and text Linear 768 → 256 are trainable too
padded steps count zero; the gripper column can be re-weighted
loss = Σ mask · w · |â − a| / (6 · valid steps)
BERT · frozen, not in the optimizer
weight decay 1e-10 · no accumulation by default
linear warm-up, then cosine to 5 % of the base rate
every 5,000 steps, written to the run folder
